## Checklist

- [ ] `task lint` and `task test` pass
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`type(scope): msg`)
- [ ] Regenerated code is committed if inputs changed (`task generate` after touching `api/openapi.yaml`, `ent/schema/`, or a mocked interface)
- [ ] New config keys are in `config.defaults()` and `api/config.schema.json`
- [ ] `docs/ROADMAP.md` updated if this ships or starts a roadmap feature
- [ ] I've read the diff and can explain every line — noted below if AI-assisted
      ([why](https://github.com/datahearth/streamline/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#ai-assisted-contributions))
